sanskrit: viśvebhiragne agnibhirimaṃ yajñamidaṃ vacaḥ . cano ghāḥ sahasā yaho panyaṃpanyamitsotāra ā dhāvata madyāya . somaṃ vīrāya śūrāya agniḥ pratnena janmanā śumbhānastanvā3ṃ svām . kavirvipreṇa vavṛdhe
english: O Agni, with all fires, this sacrifice, this word — grant us delight by your might, O mighty one. O pressers, hasten to the inebriating soma, each one praiseworthy. The soma for the hero, for the warrior. Agni, with his ancient birth, adorning his own body, has grown great among the inspired seers.

sanskrit: yacciddhi śaśvā tanā devaṃdevaṃ yajāmahe . tve iddhūyate haviḥ eha harī brahmayujā śagmā vakṣataḥ sakhāyam . indraṃ gīrbhirgirvaṇasam ūrjjo napātamā huve 'gniṃ pāvakaśociṣam . asminyajñe svadhvare
english: Even though we worship god after god throughout all time, to you alone the oblation is poured. Let the two bay steeds, yoked by prayer, bring hither a friend with good fortune — Indra, beloved of hymns. I call the offspring of strength, Agni of purifying flame, in this our well-conducted sacrifice.

sanskrit: priyo no astu viśpatirhotā mandro vareṇyaḥ . priyāḥ svagnayo vayam pātā vṛtrahā sutamā ghā gamannāre asmat . ni yamate śatamūtiḥ sa no mitramahastvamagne śukreṇa śociṣā . devairā satsi barhiṣi
english: May the lord of the clan, the joyful, excellent invoking priest, be dear to us. We who have good fires are dear. Let the slayer of Vṛtra guard the pressed soma; may he come not far from us. The hundred-aided one is restrained. You, Agni, great as a friend to us, with your bright flame, seat yourself on the sacred grass among the gods.

sanskrit: asmākamastu kevalaḥ na tvāmindrāti ricyate nudasva yāḥ parispṛdhaḥ
english: May he be ours alone — none surpasses you, O Indra. Drive away those who compete against us.

sanskrit: sa no vṛṣannamuṃ caruṃ satrādāvannapā vṛdhi . asmabhyamapratiṣkutaḥ vivyaktha mahinā vṛṣanbhakṣaṃ somasya jāgṛve . ya indra jaṭhareṣu te ayā nijaghnirojasā rathasaṅge dhane hite . stavā abibhyuṣā hṛdā
english: O bull-like one, increase that offering for us, the all-bestowing giver, with food. For us, O unchallenged bull, you have manifested the share of soma by your greatness to the wakeful one. O Indra, those whom you have slain in your belly with power, when the prize is set and the chariot encounter fixed — let them be praised with a fearless heart.

sanskrit: bṛṣā yūtheva vaṃsagaḥ kṛṣṭīriyartyojasā . īśāno apratiṣkutaḥ araṃ ta indra kukṣaye somo bhavatu vṛtrahan . araṃ dhāmabhya indavaḥ asya vratāni nādhṛṣe pavamānasya dūḍhyā . ruja yastvā pṛtanyati
english: The bull, like a herd-leader following the herd, stirs the peoples with his might, ruling unchallenged. Let the soma fill your belly, O Indra, slayer of Vṛtra. Let the drops flow properly to his stations. The ordinances of the flowing one are not to be transgressed, with ill intent. Break whoever fights against you.

sanskrit: taṃ hinvanti madacyutaṃ hariṃ nadīṣu vājinam . indumindrāya matsaram
english: They urge him on — the intoxication-shedding, tawny, swift one through the streams — the exhilarating drop for Indra.

sanskrit: asya rāyastvamagne rathīrasi vidā gādhaṃ tuce tu naḥ stomaṃ rudrāya dṛśīkam mā tvā ke cinni yemurinna pāśino 'ti dhanveva tāṃ ihi
english: O Agni, you are the charioteer of his riches; find us a firm footing. A hymn visible to Rudra is for us. Let none restrain you, not the snare-casters; go beyond them as over a desert.

sanskrit: parṣi tokaṃ tanayaṃ partṛbhiṣṭvamadabdhairaprayutvabhiḥ . agne heḍāṃsi daivyā yuyodhi no 'devāni harāṃsi ca sa no mahāṃ animāno dhūmaketuḥ puruścandraḥ . dhiye vājāya hinvatu vṛtrakhādo valaṃ rujaḥ purāṃ darmo apāmajaḥ . sthātā rathasya haryorabhisvara indro dṛḍhā cidārujaḥ
english: You carry across our offspring and progeny, O Agni, with your unfailing, undeflected guides. Ward off from us the divine wrath and the ungodly offences as well. May he — great, haughty, smoke-bannered, richly brilliant — impel us toward thought and strength. The eater of Vṛtra breaks open Vala, the destroyer of forts, the conqueror of waters. Indra, the stander in the chariot with the two bays, resounding, breaks even what is firm.

sanskrit: sa revāṃ iva viśpatirdaivyaḥ ketuḥ śṛṇotu naḥ . ukthairagnirbṛhadbhānuḥ gambhīrāṃ udadhīṃriva kratuṃ puṣyasi gā iva . pra sugopā yavasaṃ dhenavo yathā hradaṃ kulyā ivāśata
english: May the divine signal, the lord of the tribe, like a rich man, hear us through our hymns. Agni of vast brilliance, you nurture wisdom deep as the ocean, as cows nourish. As well-tended cows seek pasture, as streams seek a lake, so the well-guarded ones proceed forth.

sanskrit: mā varpo asmadapa gūha etadyadanyarūpaḥ samithe babhūtha śaṃ yadgave na śākine āpitve naḥ prapitve tūyamā gahi kaṇveṣu su sacā piba
english: Do not conceal that beauty from us — the form you assumed different in the assembly. What is auspicious for the capable cow — come to us swiftly at our encounter and at our departure. Among the Kaṇvas, come along and drink well.

sanskrit: pra tatte adya śipiviṣṭa havyamaryaḥ śaṃsāmi vayunāni vidvān . taṃ tvā gṛṇāmi tavasamatavyānkṣayantamasya rajasaḥ parāke na ghā vasurni yamate dānaṃ vājasya gomataḥ . yatsīmupaśravadgiraḥ mandantu tvā maghavannindrendavo rādhodeyāya sunvate . āmuṣyā somamapibaścamū sutaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ taddadhiṣe sahaḥ
english: Today, O Viṣṇu who pervades all, a man proclaims your oblation; knowing the ways, I praise you. I laud you — the most mighty, most powerful, ruling afar over this dust. The gift of prize cattle is never withheld, the wealth, from the generous one. Whenever the hymns shall reach his hearing, may the drops exhilarate you, O Maghavan Indra, for the generous one who presses. From that vessel you drank the pressed soma; that power you hold as chief.

sanskrit: vaṣaṭ te viṣṇavāsa ā kṛṇomi tanme juṣasva śipiviṣṭa havyam . vardhantu tvā suṣṭutayo giri me yūyaṃ pāta svastabhiḥ sadā naḥ kuvitsasya pra hi vrajaṃ gomantaṃ dasyuhā gamat . śacībhirapa no varat
english: Vaṣaṭ! O Viṣṇu, to your dwelling I bring this; O Śipiviṣṭa, be pleased with this oblation. May excellent praises increase you, O mountain; do you all always protect us with blessings. May the slayer of the Dasyu go forth to the cattle-pen of one seeking goods — may he turn it away from us with his powers.

sanskrit: ā yāhi somapītaye spārho deva niyutvatā samūḍhamasya pāṃsule na tvadanyo maghavannasti marḍitendra bravīmi te vacaḥ
english: Come, O desirable god, with your team of steeds for the drinking of soma — the one overwhelmed by his dust. There is no comforter other than you, O Maghavan; I speak this word to you, O Indra.

sanskrit: indraśca vāyaveṣāṃ somānāṃ pītimarhathaḥ . yuvāṃ hi yantīndavo nimnamāpo na sadhryak trīṇi padā vi cakrame viṣṇurgopā adābhyaḥ . ato dharmāṇi dhārayan mā te rādhāṃsi mā ta ūtayo vaso 'smānkadā canā dabhan . viśvā ca na upamimīhi mānuṣa vasūni carṣaṇibhya ā
english: Indra and Vāyu deserve the drinking of these somas, for the drops flow toward you two together like water to a low place. Viṣṇu, the undeceivable guardian, strode out three paces, upholding the cosmic laws from that point. May your bounties, may your aids, O Vasu, never fail us. Measure out for us all human riches for the peoples.

sanskrit: vāyavindraśca śuṣmiṇā sarathaṃ śavasaspatī . niyutvantā na ūtaya ā yātaṃ somapītaye viṣṇoḥ karmāṇi paśyata yato vratāni paspaśe . indrasya yujyaḥ sakhā
english: Vāyu and Indra, mighty, lords of strength, with the same chariot — may your aids come, you who have troops of steeds; come for the drinking of soma. Behold the deeds of Viṣṇu, from which he observed the cosmic laws — the dear companion of Indra.

sanskrit: tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padaṃ sadā paśyanti sūrayaḥ . divīva cakṣurātatam
english: That highest footstep of Viṣṇu the wise men always behold, like an eye stretched across the sky.

sanskrit: tadviprāso vipanyuvo jāgṛvāṃsaḥ samindhate . viṣṇoryatparamaṃ padam
english: That highest footstep of Viṣṇu the inspired ones, the hymn-singers, wakefully kindle.

sanskrit: ato devā avantu no yato viṣṇurvicakrame . pṛthivyā adhi sānavi
english: From that place whence Viṣṇu strode, upon the ridge of the earth, may the gods protect us.

sanskrit: yadī vivasvato dhiyo hariṃ hinvanti yātave ārāttādva sadhamādaṃ na ā gahīha vā sannupa śrudhi divo adarśi duhitā
english: When the thoughts of Vivasvat urge the tawny one to journey — come hither to the common rejoicing from afar, or being near, hear us. The daughter of heaven has been seen.

sanskrit: tamasya marjayāmasi mado ya indrapātamaḥ . yaṃ gāva āsabhirdadhuḥ purā nūnaṃ ca sūrayaḥ ime hi te brahmakṛtaḥ sute sacā madhau na makṣa āsate . indre kāmaṃ jaritāro vasūyavo rathe na pādamā dadhuḥ aśveva citrāruṣī mātā gavāmṛtāvarī . sakhā bhūdaśvinoruṣāḥ
english: We cleanse that exhilaration of his which is most drunk by Indra, which the cows have placed with their mouths both of old and now, and the inspired ones. For these, made by sacred prayer, sit together in the pressed soma as flies in honey. The singers, eager for wealth, have placed their desire in Indra as a foot in a chariot. Like a brilliant red mare, the variegated mother of the cows, the guardian of truth — Dawn has become the friend of the Aśvins.

sanskrit: taṃ gāthayā purāṇyā punānamabhyanūṣata . uto kṛpanta dhītayo devānāṃ nāma bibhratīḥ uta sakhāsyaśvinoruta mātā gavāmasi . utoṣo vasva īśiṣe
english: With the ancient song they have followed the purifying one as he flows. And the devotions bearing the names of the gods have shone forth. You are also the friend of the Aśvins, and also the mother of the cows, and also, O Dawn, you rule over wealth.

sanskrit: samrājantamadhvarāṇām pūrvīrṛtasya bṛhatīranūṣata stoturmedhā asṛkṣata stuṣe vāmaśvinā bṛhat
english: The many great songs of truth have sung after the universal sovereign of the sacrifices; the wisdom of the praiser has been released. I praise you two greatly, O Aśvins.

sanskrit: sa ghā naḥ sūnuḥ śavasā pṛthupragāmā suśevaḥ . mīḍhvāṃ asmākaṃ babhūyāt samindro rāyo bṛhatīradhūnuta saṃ kṣoṇī samu sūryam . saṃ śukrāsaḥ śucayaḥ saṃ gavāśiraḥ somā indramamandiṣuḥ yā dasrā sindhumātarā manotarā rayīṇām . dhiyā devā vasuvidā
english: May that son of ours, moving wide with strength, gracious and bountiful, become ours. Indra shook together the great riches, the two earths together, and the sun together. The bright, pure, cow-mixed somas have delighted Indra together. You two wondrous ones, born of rivers, swifter than thought in riches — with devotion, O gods who find wealth.

sanskrit: sa no dūrāccāsācca ni martyādaghāyoḥ . pāhi sadamidviśvāyuḥ vacyante vāṃ kakuhāso jūrṇāyāmadhi viṣṭapi . yadvāṃ ratho vibhiṣpatāt
english: Protect us always, O all-life-giving one, from the mortal who plots evil, both from afar and from near. The eminent ones call out to you two upon the ancient expanse. Whenever your chariot rides scattering fear.

sanskrit: aśastihā janitā vṛtratūrasi tvaṃ tūrya taruṣyataḥ yena tokaṃ ca tanayaṃ ca dhāmahe
english: You are the slayer of the slanderer, the begetter, swift against Vṛtra; you are swift against one who would overcome, by whom we sustain both offspring and progeny.

sanskrit: anu te śuṣmaṃ turayantamīyatuḥ kṣoṇī śiśuṃ na mātarā . viśvāste spṛdhaḥ śnathayanta manyave vṛtraṃ yadindra tūrvasi nare ca dakṣiṇāvate devāya sadanāsade taṃ sakhāyaḥ purūrucaṃ yūyaṃ vayaṃ ca sūrayaḥ . aśyāma vājagandhyaṃ sanema vājapastyam uṣo adyeha gomatyaśvāvati vibhāvari . revadasme vyuccha sūnṛtāvati
english: The two earths have followed after your rushing strength like two mothers after a child. All your rivals are crushed by your wrath when you overcome Vṛtra, O Indra. To that hero, the righteous, the god who dwells in the abode — to him the companions, greatly shining, and we and the inspired ones shall attain the prize-winning, shall win the prize-home. O Dawn, today shine here richly with cows and horses, O brilliant one, shining with truth.

sanskrit: pari tyaṃ haryataṃ hariṃ babhruṃ punanti vāreṇa . yo devānviśvāṃ itpari madena saha gacchati yuṅkṣvā hi vājinīvatyaśvāṃ adyāruṇāṃ uṣaḥ . athā no viśvā saubhagānyā vaha
english: They purify that beloved, tawny, ruddy one with a filter, the one who goes beyond all gods together with exhilaration. Yoke the ruddy horses today, O Dawn, you who have prize-winning mares. Then bring us all good fortunes.

sanskrit: cakrāṇa opaśaṃ divi śraddhā ittemaghavan pārye divi vājī vājaṃ siṣāsati arvāgrathaṃ samanasā ni yacchatam
english: Making a support in the sky — faith indeed in this, O Maghavan, at the distant sky. The prize-winning one seeks to win the prize; hold back the chariot hither with one mind.

sanskrit: vyā3ntarikṣamatiranmade somasya rocanā . indro yadabhinadvalam maghonaḥ sma vṛtrahatyeṣu codaya ye dadati priyā vasu . tava praṇītī haryaśva sūribhirviśvā tarema duritā eha devā mayobhuvā dasrā hiraṇyavarttanī . uṣarbudho vahantu somapītaye
english: The bright lights of soma overflowed the midair in exhilaration when Indra struck Vala open. Urge on the generous ones to the slayings of Vṛtra, those who give dear wealth. Under your guidance, O bay-horsed one, may we with the inspired ones cross all difficulties. Come hither, O gods bringing well-being, O wondrous ones of golden wheels, awakening at dawn; bring us for the drinking of soma.

sanskrit: udagā ājadaṅgirobhya āviṣkṛṇvanguhā satīḥ . arvāñcaṃ nunude valam yāvitthā ślokamā divo jyotirjanāya cakrathuḥ . ā na ūrjaṃ vahatamaśvinā yuvam
english: He rose up, drove toward the Aṅgirases, making manifest those who were hidden. He pushed Vala toward this side. As far as you two have spread the resonant sound, the light of heaven for the people — carry nourishment to us, O you two Aśvins.
